text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A new year—
This year,
I was visiting the Rose clan's villa.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It varies from year to year.
At times I am invited to soirees,
while at others I spend the days at a
chateau
owned by our clan in France.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Out of consideration for me,
Mother arranged
a peaceful reprieve this year.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I invited you this time thinking it would
allow you to unwind and relax as well,
but—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...
Did it... have the opposite effect?
choice_data_list: No, that's not what I meant—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though admittedly, rather than restful,
it was one shock after another.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A kadomatsu so extravagant it hardly seemed
meant for a home,
a gold folding screen crafted with pure gold
leaf by a renowned artist,
and top-shelf sake bearing a terrifying
price tag—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though I stand as an ally to the Rose
Clan,
I still cannot seem to get used to the vast
gulf between our worlds.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(It is likely no lie.
Even so,
I would have you rest both body and mind,
given the opportunity.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...All right,
I have a few suggestions for you.
Let us go with whichever one piques your
interest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With that, what she presented to me was—
choice_data_list: Go listen to the koto performance
Go look at the view outside

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
A koto player, is it?
I, too, am fond of the koto's timbre.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she said she's going to listen to a
musical performance,
I presume she must be heading out.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...?
No, there is no need to go out.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
A koto player with close ties to my
family.
We invite them every year just like this.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
While the notes she plays are light and airy,
there is a certain
depth to them as well―― Hearing them at the
start of the year
makes one stand all the straighter.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A New Year's Day where a koto player was
invited
for a live performance,
even without a banquet—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though I was deeply shaken...
the performance itself
was profoundly cleansing for the soul.
choice_data_list: It is a truly beautiful tone.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...I see, that is good.
I shall listen a while longer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Nikkei Shinshun Hai is just around the
corner.
To repay her thoughtfulness in giving me
time to rest,
I want to face it at her side with everything
I have.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Amazake, is it?
I, too,
am quite fond of my family's amazake.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
If we ask the chef,
he should be able to prepare it right away.
Come.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—The subtle sweetness permeates my body.
Delicious, as expected.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
It is a culinary masterpiece crafted by my
family's chef,
utilizing authentic French long-grain
rice.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I hear it all began when my ancestor,
having just crossed over from France,
had the chef at the time brew a trial
batch of
amazake using French rice as a playful
whim.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
To cater to my ancestor's tastes,
it was flavored to be
just a bit sweeter than ordinary amazake――

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
What is the matter?
Was it not to your liking?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In ordinary households,
one doesn't have a personal chef
brew amazake from a generations-old family
recipe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though rattled by just how different our
worlds were, I had to admit—
the amazake she gave me was truly
exquisite.
choice_data_list: ...I am deeply moved by such a val...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see.
I hear refills are available as well.
Please, drink to your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Nikkei Shinshun Hai is just around the
corner.
To repay her thoughtfulness in giving me
time to rest,
I want to face it at her side with everything
I have.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
...The sun will be setting soon.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
There is a wonderful view.
It should bring further peace to your
heart.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Heh—
No matter when I visit,
this place is always dressed in summer
attire.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Above all, I love this scenery.
The horizon illuminated by the setting
sun.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beyond the line of her gaze――
Indeed, a beautiful,
pale pink water surface rippled gently.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
In my childhood,
I would visit in the summer with the elder
ladies of our clan,
frolicking in the pool.
And when evening fell,
we would all gaze out upon the scenery
together.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
There were days when we sat and spoke at
length
about the future of the Rose Clan.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...
To think the day would come when I could
visit this place with you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Let us linger in leisure a while longer.
This is our time to rest, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Nikkei Shinshun Hai is just around the
corner.
To repay her thoughtfulness in giving me
time to rest,
I want to face it at her side with everything
I have.
